messages:
sre-oncall: Investigating a spike in GPU pod terminations in eu-central. Multiple customers reporting 503s to inference API. I'm collecting node & kernel logs.

eng-nodes: I'm seeing NIC errors and 'link is down' messages on several g5a instances. dmesg shows repeated firmware link resets. Starting node reprovisioning for two affected hosts.

eng-runtime: Observed massive KV cache evictions after pod restarts. Might be follow-on due to node flaps, not root cause.

sre-oncall: Quick dump:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep eu-central
inference-abc-1   CrashLoopBackOff   0/3   0    5m   10.2.3.5   node-g5a-12
inference-def-2   Running            3/3   0    2h   10.2.3.8   node-g5a-14
```

status-bot: Incident page created: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-20260302-euc1 (updated)

support-lead: We're getting P1-level alerts from AcmeCorp, BetaApps, DataSmith. Need an ETA and mitigation plan to pass to customers.

maya: AcmeCorp is live traffic. They want an ETA now. Can we confirm failover options?

sre-oncall: Short-term plan: shift traffic off eu-central using smart routing. Start at 10% to eu-west, 5% to us-west, monitor for 10m, then ramp. Will also enable reserved burst capacity for affected orgs as fallback.

eng-platform: Running traffic-shift runbook now. Commands:
```
redwoodctl route modify --policy smart-route-v2 --region eu-central --weight 0.1
redwoodctl route modify --policy smart-route-v2 --region eu-west --weight 0.6
```
I'll watch the rollout and healthchecks.

support-lead: Drafting customer message to send now. Preview:
```
Status: Partial outage in eu-central affecting inference calls.
Action: Traffic is being shifted to alternate regions; no action required from you.
ETA next update: 20 minutes. Mitigation ETA: ~45 minutes.
```
Sending to AcmeCorp & BetaApps.

sre-oncall: Enabled dedicated fallback pool (reserved-dedicated) for org-123 (AcmeCorp). Note: this will increase compute spend for 24h if used. @finance FYI.

finance: Acknowledged — flagging for post-incident billing review. If we need to absorb costs, escalate via SLT.

eng-ml: We'll pre-warm model caches in eu-west and us-west to reduce latency bump. Spawning 3 warm replicas now.

sre-oncall: Metrics: after initial 10% shift, 503 errors down ~60%, request latency stable. Continuing ramp to 50% over next 15m if no regressions.

support-lead: Messages sent. AcmeCorp support rep acknowledged, asked for per-tenant logs. Will coordinate with eng-runtime.

eng-runtime: We don't see any dropped requests in the ingress logs; mainly timeouts and kubelet restarts. Compiling per-tenant request counts for last 30m.

maya: Thanks. Keep me posted — if AcmeCorp needs an emergency SLA credit, prepare timeline.

alan: :thumbsup:

support-lead: Next update planned in 15m with status page link. Thanks team.

sre-oncall: continuing to monitor. Root cause is likely NIC firmware flapping; nodes reprovisioning underway. Last status update 1767329901.
